items.title: OpenAI Warns macOS Users to Update ChatGPT and Codex Immediately
items.description: OpenAI has disclosed a security incident tied to the compromise of Axios, a widely used third-party JavaScript developer library, as part of a broader software supply chain attack detected on March 31, 2026.
